title: feat(ui): record-mode currency — each record shows its own currency; ISO 4217 code select pre-filled with the organization currency; no cross-currency totals; Studio currency section
body:
epic:#8345#1 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbTZrFqRYNgjSaSbN5

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg9oTskgBVZmtxXLAEh251Cb)_

Fixes #27188

Merge-after: #27268
⛔ not released alone — R1: pairs with #27184, #27186, #27187, #27188 (one Version Packages release)
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** record 模式的金额按每条记录自己的币种显示（列表、表单、详情、仪表盘、甘特提示）；币种码字段变成 ISO 4217 分组搜索下拉，「可用」组含组织币种和该对象已用过的币种，新建时预填组织币种；列表筛选里 record 金额条件带必填币种选择，生成「金额条件 且 币种 = C」；列表页脚与非按币种分组的合计不再跨币种相加；Studio 字段编辑器新增币种模式、币种字段选择和「创建币种字段」。
- **为什么改：** 没有这一步，record 字段会显示租户币种符号，比今天更错（ADR-0144 D9：R1 必含）。
- **风险与回滚：** 只影响声明 `currencyMode: 'record'` 的字段和声明 ISO 4217 值域的文本字段；dynamic / fixed 字段行为不变（原有测试全过）。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看：** `ui/packages/i18n/src/currency.ts`（解析器，record 分支）、`ui/packages/components/src/custom/filterRecordCurrency.ts`（筛选配对）、`ui/packages/components/src/renderers/form/usedCurrencyCodes.ts`（已用币种查询）、`ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/recordCurrencyAggregates.ts`（合计规则）。
- **两分钟验证：** `cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/fields/src/__tests__/recordCurrency.faces-27188.test.tsx`，应见三行 $ / € / ¥，无币种的行显示纯数字。
- **需要你做的：** 无，席位落地（合并顺序在 #27268 之后）。

## What changes

ADR-0144 D2 (the record currency lives in a sibling code field), D6 (raw aggregates over a record-mode amount stand only inside one currency) and D8 rule 4 (the form pre-fills the organization currency; the stored value is always explicit), on the renderer side.

- **Resolver** (`@object-ui/i18n`). `resolveFieldCurrency(field, tenantDefault, record?)` gains an optional record. Under `currencyMode: 'record'` it reads only `record[currencyConfig.currencyField]`; no record or a blank code resolves to `undefined`, so the face shows a plain number. It never falls back to the tenant default, a node-level `currency` or a stray `defaultCurrency`. `dynamic` / `fixed` are unchanged. New `recordCurrencyField(field)` names the pointer; `FieldCurrencyConfig` types the three modes.
- **Faces that hold the record now pass it.** `CurrencyCellRenderer` and the formula cell (the grid already hands `dependentValues={row}`), `CurrencyField` (symbol, minor-unit decimals and spinner step follow the selected code), the form renderer (hands the live record to the `currency` and `formula` widgets, `RECORD_CURRENCY_WIDGET_TYPES`), the grid's mobile card, the record page's summary chips, the dashboard table cell and record drawer (`FieldMeta.currencyConfig`, copied only for record mode), and Gantt tooltips.
- **Code field.** A `text` field declaring `valueDomain: 'iso_4217_currency'` renders `CurrencyCodeField`: a searchable select grouped "Available" (home currency, then rated, then the codes in use) and "All currencies (ISO 4217)", offering only codes `isValueDomainMember('iso_4217_currency', code)` accepts. Re-selecting the selected code keeps it (no click-to-clear). The picker is `CurrencyCodePicker` in `@object-ui/components`, shared with the filter row below.
- **Used codes** (`@object-ui/components` form renderer, `usedCurrencyCodes.ts`). For every ISO 4217 code field on a form with an `objectName`, the renderer asks `dataSource.queryGroupHeaders(object, compileListViewGroupQuery(grouped by the code field))` once, keyed on content, and hands the distinct stored codes down on the field's own metadata as `usedCurrencyCodes`. No widget-contract key. All six plugin-form hosts already put `objectName` on the form schema, so this one seam covers them. A data source without `queryGroupHeaders` is not asked (`aggregate` may degrade to a full fetch); a failed read hands nothing down. Either way the picker offers home + rated + the record's own code.
- **Filters** (`@object-ui/components` FilterBuilder, `@object-ui/plugin-list`). A builder field entry may carry `currencyField` (the list sets it from `currencyConfig` for record-mode amounts). A value-comparing row on such an amount draws a required currency picker, defaulting to `localization.currency`. The builder emits the code condition as a companion row of the same flat group, `{ id: '<row id>::currency', field: <code field>, operator: 'equals', value: C }`, so the group lowers to `amount op X AND code = C` everywhere it is lowered (`convertFilterGroupToAST` gives `['and', ['amount','>',100], ['currency_code','=','USD']]`) and stored filters keep the `ViewFilterRule` shape. The companion is drawn as the picker, never as a row, and goes when its amount row goes, switches to a non-pairing field, or switches to a presence operator. A paired group cannot be toggled to OR, because under OR the pair would split; a stored OR group shows why. Opening a stored filter emits nothing (a stored amount row without a code shows a blank, invalid picker until the next edit). The toolbar's filter count does not count companions.
- **Create forms** (`@object-ui/plugin-form`). `SeedContext.homeCurrency`: a code field that some record-mode amount points at, with no declared default, opens on `localization.currency`. Wired into ObjectForm, DrawerForm, ModalForm, SplitForm, TabbedForm and WizardForm. Edit forms are not seeded, so opening a record never rewrites its stored code.
- **Totals** (`@object-ui/plugin-grid`). The footer draws no sum / avg / min / max for a record-mode amount; counts stand. Group-header aggregations keep those only when the grid is grouped by the amount's code field (`honestGroupAggregations`, applied before both the server header query and client bucketing). The home field is a `dynamic` amount and totals as before.
- **Studio** (`@object-ui/app-shell`). A currency field, or a formula returning `currency`, gets a currency section (`CurrencyConfigField`): mode, the fixed code, and under `record` a `currencyField` picker listing only the object's `text` + ISO 4217 fields, with "Create currency field", which appends `currency_code` (`type: 'text'`, `valueDomain: 'iso_4217_currency'`, `required: true`) and sets the pointer in one write. A mode switch keeps only the keys that mode reads.
- **i18n.** `fields.currencyCode.*` in all eleven locale packs; `designer.field.currency.*` in the studio namespace (en, zh).

File surface beyond the Claim's list, accepted by the epic PM: `ui/packages/plugin-grid`, `ui/packages/components`; also `ui/packages/plugin-form`, `ui/packages/plugin-detail`, `ui/packages/plugin-gantt` (one resolver call each, plus the form seeding), and `ui/packages/plugin-list` (the list filter's `currencyField` and filter count).

## Tests

- `i18n/src/__tests__/resolveFieldCurrency.recordMode-27188.test.ts` — the record-mode truth table.
- `fields/src/__tests__/recordCurrency.faces-27188.test.tsx` — cells in USD / EUR / JPY, no-code rows plain, the amount box's symbol and step (USD 0.01, JPY 1, KWD 0.001), the code select's groups and domain filter, `TextField` routing.
- `plugin-form/src/__tests__/recordCurrencySeed-27188.test.ts` — seeding, unset setting, author default and caller record win.
- `plugin-grid/src/__tests__/recordCurrencyAggregates-27188.test.tsx` — footer refuses money aggregates over record mode, counts stand, home field sums; group aggregations by grouping field.
- `plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/recordFields.recordCurrency-27188.test.tsx` — dashboard cells per row.
- `app-shell/.../CurrencyConfigField.recordMode-27188.test.tsx` — mode switch, candidates, and the create shortcut's output parses under `ObjectSchema`.
- `components/src/renderers/form/__tests__/form-used-currency-codes-27188.test.tsx` — the query shape, the distinct domain-valid read, one ask per object across re-renders, no ask without an object or the capability, a failed read.
- `components/src/__tests__/filter-builder-record-currency-27188.test.tsx` — the pairing rules, one picker per paired row, a new row on the home currency, removal, the stored blank picker emitting nothing, the AND lock and the OR notice.
- `plugin-list/src/__tests__/convertFilterGroupToAST.recordCurrency-27188.test.ts` — the pair lowers to `amount op X AND code = C`.
- `fields/.../recordCurrency.faces-27188.test.tsx` gains: the used codes off `field.usedCurrencyCodes` appear in "Available" after the home currency.

## Acceptance notes

- **Seat ruling: A/A** (epic PM, on the two open questions of the first report). (1) The form reads the used codes once per object and passes them on the field metadata, with no widget-contract key. (2) The filter row gets a required currency picker defaulting to the organization currency, and the builder emits `amount op X AND code = C`. Both are built here.
- **Rated group is a seam.** `ratedCurrencyCodes()` in `CurrencyCodeField.tsx` returns nothing until `sys_exchange_rate` ships (R2, #27185).
- **Used codes, where asked.** The read rides the form renderer, the seam every form host already reaches with `objectName`, rather than six host-level copies. It is a per-mount read: a code first used after the form opened shows up on the next open.
- **Filter scope.** The pairing is the list's filter builder (`FilterBuilder` + `ListView`). The sharing-rule criteria editor (`FilterConditionField`, stored as a Mongo-style object) is not paired: it re-ids rows on every read, so a code condition there stays a row the author writes.
- **No organization currency.** With `localization.currency` unset a new pair's code is blank and the picker is marked invalid; the list's lowering drops a blank row, so that filter compares the amount alone until a code is picked.
- **Minor units.** The amount box reads the existing `currencyDisplayWidth` / `currencyFractionDigits` reader (CLDR via `Intl`), which `CURRENCY_FRACTION_DIGITS` mirrors by construction (its header); no second table.
- **Home field display** (`homeAmount`) is #27196's.
- **Metric tiles** already show a plain number for a record-mode aggregate (the resolver has no record); the build-time refusal is #27187's.
